name: awesome-decentralized
desc: 🕶 Awesome list of distributed, decentralized, p2p apps and tools 👍

resources.name: Aether
resources.desc: P2P ephemeral public communities. Open source, self-governing

resources.name: Agregore
resources.desc: A minimalistic web browser that supports multiple peer-to-peer protocols and is extensible with standard WebExtensions.

resources.name: airpaste ☠️
resources.desc: A 1-1 network pipe that auto discovers other peers using mdns. Can send text or files.

resources.name: Airshare
resources.desc: CLI tool and module for transferring data between 2 machines in a local network, P2P, using Multicast-DNS. Works completely offline.

resources.name: AKASHA
resources.desc: A Next-Generation Social Media Network. Powered by the Ethereum world computer. Embedded into the Inter-Planetary File System.

resources.name: Beaker
resources.desc: Experimental browser. It adds new technologies for Peer-to-Peer applications while staying compatible with the rest of the Web.

resources.name: Berty
resources.desc: secure peer-to-peer messaging app that works with or without internet access, cellular data or trust in the network.

resources.name: Bitchat
resources.desc: A decentralized peer-to-peer messaging app that works over Bluetooth mesh networks. No internet required, no servers, no phone numbers. It's the side-groupchat.

resources.name: Bitmessage
resources.desc: P2P communications protocol used to send encrypted messages to another person or to many subscribers.

resources.name: Cabal
resources.desc: P2P community offline-first chat platform.

resources.name: CacheP2P
resources.desc: highly distributed cache platform based on WebTorrent and runs only in the browser.

resources.name: Cactus Comments
resources.desc: Federated comment system for the open web built on Matrix.

resources.name: croc
resources.desc: Easily and securely send files and folders from one computer to another in command line.

resources.name: Cryptor
resources.desc: Overlay P2P network that values your privacy and anonymity above all else. Packages and some clients included.

resources.name: Dat desktop app
resources.desc: Decentralized data tool for distributing data small and large.

resources.name: Databag
resources.desc: Self-hosted lightweight federated messenger for the decentralized web. Lightweight, public-private key based identity, end-to-end encryption.

resources.name: DB3 Network
resources.desc: Decentralized Firebase Firestore Alternative

resources.name: Deltachat
resources.desc: Delta Chat is like Telegram or Whatsapp but without the tracking or central control. It doesn't have their own servers but uses the most massive and diverse open messaging system ever: the existing e-mail server network. Chat with anyone if you know their e-mail address, no need for them to install DeltaChat, all you need is a standard e-mail account.

resources.name: Demonsaw
resources.desc: Secure and anonymous information sharing application that makes security simple and gives you back control of your data.

resources.name: Diaspora
resources.desc: A privacy-aware, distributed, open source social network. Main pod is at Diasp.eu.

resources.name: Dropub ☠️
resources.desc: Share files for free on the internet. It's like Dropbox meets BitTorrent.

resources.name: Dumb pipe
resources.desc: A unix pipe between computers. Connect A to B. Send Data.

resources.name: Element (formerly Riot)
resources.desc: Collaboration client for the web. Chat, VOIP video, file transfer, end-to-end crypto.

resources.name: Fernweh
resources.desc: Fernweh is a messaging app that works without internet. It operates through a sophisticated decentralized mesh networking architecture that transforms ordinary smartphones into communication hubs, enabling seamless messaging without any internet or cellular connectivity.

resources.name: FileLove
resources.desc: Minimal p2p file transfer right in the browser, using WebTorrent.

resources.name: FilePizza ☠️
resources.desc: Free peer-to-peer file transfers in your browser.

resources.name: Fred
resources.desc: Freenet REference Daemon. Also: freenetproject.org

resources.name: Friendica
resources.desc: Decentralised communications platform that integrates social communication. Connect effortlessly to a federated communications network of several thousand servers, with more than half a million users. Directly connect to anyone on Friendica, Mastodon, Diaspora, GnuSocial, Pleroma, or Hubzilla, regardless of where each user profile is hosted.

resources.name: Friends ☠️
resources.desc: P2P chat powered by the web. This project is alpha quality.

resources.name: Galacteek
resources.desc: Browser and dapps platform for the distributed web.

resources.name: Handshake
resources.desc: Decentralized, permissionless naming protocol compatible with DNS where every peer is validating and in charge of managing the root zone with the goal of creating an alternative to existing Certificate Authorities.

resources.name: Hardbin
resources.desc: Encrypted pastebin using IPFS.

resources.name: Hidden Lake
resources.desc: Anonymous network with theoretical provability to a global observer. It is based on the problem of queues.

resources.name: Hubzilla
resources.desc: General purpose platform for creating interconnected websites featuring a decentralized identity, communications, and permissions framework built using common webserver technology.

resources.name: Hyperpad
resources.desc: Peer-to-peer collaborative text editor.

resources.name: I2P
resources.desc: Anonymous network, exposing a simple layer that applications can use to anonymously and securely send messages to each other.

resources.name: instant.io
resources.desc: Streaming file transfer over WebTorrent (torrents on the web).

resources.name: IPFS bin ☠️
resources.desc: Pastebin application for sharing code and text documents to other people.

resources.name: IPFS Desktop
resources.desc: A native application to run your own IPFS Node.

resources.name: ipfs-chat
resources.desc: Terminal-based, secure chatrooms using IPFS. Works over both LAN and internet (includes NAT traversal). Supports private-messaging and file/directory sharing.

resources.name: ipfs-pinner
resources.desc: A toolkit helps upload files to IPFS pinning services such as Infura, Pinata, NFT.Storage and Web3.Storage.

resources.name: iWant ☠️
resources.desc: Commandline tool for searching and downloading files in LAN network, without any central server.

resources.name: Jami
resources.desc: Free and universal communication platform which preserves the user's privacy and freedoms. Desktop and mobile apps for text messaging, video and audio calls, file transfer, video conferencing.

resources.name: Keet
resources.desc: Peer to peer video & chat. Private & encrypted. Share huge files instantly.

resources.name: LCVPN
resources.desc: Light decentralized VPN in golang.

resources.name: LF
resources.desc: Fully decentralized fully replicated key/value store. Fully decentralized means anyone can run a node without obtaining special permission, and all nodes are effectively equal. Fully replicated means every node stores all data.

resources.name: MaidSafe
resources.desc: Decentralized internet and app infrastructure which rewards users for participating in the network.

resources.name: Manyverse
resources.desc: A social network off the grid. Scuttlebutt for mobile.

resources.name: Mastodon
resources.desc: Social networking, back in your hands. Follow friends, discover new ones. Publish anything you want: links, pictures, text, video. A platform that is community-owned and ad-free.

resources.name: Meshbird
resources.desc: Meshbird enables distributed private networking across geographically dispersed datacenters.

resources.name: Meshenger
resources.desc: Voice/Video Android phone App that works on the local LAN and does not need Internet access/servers/accounts.

resources.name: Mobilizon
resources.desc: A federated tool that helps you find, create and organise events.

resources.name: Netsukuku
resources.desc: Netsukuku is an alternative to the internet; it will have all of the features of the internet, such as websites, instant messaging, file transfers, DNS, etc. It functions as a mesh network or a p2p net system that generates and sustains itself autonomously. It is designed to handle an unlimited number of nodes with minimal CPU and memory resources.

resources.name: NewNode
resources.desc: Decentralized Content Distribution Network (dCDN).

resources.name: NNTPChan
resources.desc: NNTP based decentralized imageboard.

resources.name: Noms ☠️
resources.desc: Versioned, forkable, syncable decentralized database, philosophically descendant from the Git version control system. Nobody is working on this right now.

resources.name: norcal
resources.desc: P2P command-line calendar in Node.js. Can sync, link, embed, and edit offline.

resources.name: Nostr
resources.desc: A decentralized social network with a chance of working. A simple, open protocol that enables a truly censorship-resistant and global social network (https://nostr.com/)

resources.name: nuTorrent ☠️
resources.desc: A Pure Javascript BitTorrent Client. Built with Electron and React.

resources.name: OnionShare
resources.desc: Open source tool that lets you securely and anonymously share a file of any size.

resources.name: Open Bazaar
resources.desc: Decentralized network for P2P commerce online - using Bitcoin - that has no fees and no restrictions.

resources.name: Orbit
resources.desc: Distributed, serverless, peer-to-peer chat application on IPFS.

resources.name: ORC ☠️
resources.desc: Onion Routed Cloud, a decentralized, anonymous, file storage platform. It uses the Tor network.

resources.name: Orion
resources.desc: Easy to Use, Inter Planetary File System (IPFS) desktop client.

resources.name: Patchwork
resources.desc: Decentralized messaging and sharing app built on top of Secure Scuttlebutt (SSB). Another alternative interface is Patchbay.

resources.name: Peertransfer ☠️
resources.desc: Send a file p2p and e2e encrypted using nothing but your browser.

resources.name: PeerTube
resources.desc: Video streaming platform using BitTorrent directly in the web browser, with WebTorrent and Angular. Demo server at peertube.cpy.re.

resources.name: Philes
resources.desc: A simple IPFS-powered decentralized notepad app.

resources.name: Pleroma
resources.desc: Federated social networking server built on open protocols. It is compatible with GNU Social, Mastodon, and many other ActivityPub and OStatus implementations.

resources.name: Pollen
resources.desc: A decentralized messaging service that functions without any internet or mesh connection. Written in Python.

resources.name: Qaul
resources.desc: Internet independent wireless mesh communication App. Uses interlinked P2P mesh via BLE, Wifi & Internet-overlay.

resources.name: reep.io ☠️
resources.desc: Transfer files directly to another browser, your peer will be able to download the file directly from you.

resources.name: Retroshare
resources.desc: Encrypted connections between you and your friends to create a network of computers, and provides various distributed services on top of it: forums, channels, chat, mail...

resources.name: Ricochet
resources.desc: Different approach to instant messaging that doesn’t trust anyone in protecting your privacy. It uses the Tor network.

resources.name: Roll-Call
resources.desc: Free and reliable audio calls for everyone w/ browser P2P.

resources.name: SecuShare
resources.desc: A research project. Consider that it basically consists of a new Internet stack combined with a full-fledged distributed scalability alternative to cloud technology. Source code: https://gnunet.org/git/gnunet.git

resources.name: Session
resources.desc: Session is an end-to-end encrypted messenger that minimises sensitive metadata, designed and built for people who want absolute privacy and freedom from any form of surveillance.

resources.name: ShareDrop ☠️
resources.desc: Clone of Apple AirDrop service. Allows transferring files directly between devices, without having to upload them to any server first.

resources.name: SimpleX chat
resources.desc: A decentralized terminal-based chat (a mobile app coming soon) with a focus on users’ privacy. It doesn't use any global user identities (not even random IDs), supports groups and sending files.

resources.name: SocialHome
resources.desc: Federated personal profile with social networking functionality. Users can create rich content using Markdown and even HTML/JS/CSS. All content can be pinned to the user profile and all content will federate to contacts in the federated social web.

resources.name: Steemit
resources.desc: Blockchain-based social media platform where anyone can earn rewards.

resources.name: Storj
resources.desc: Blockchain-based, end-to-end encrypted, distributed object storage, where only you have access to your data.

resources.name: Syncthing-GTK
resources.desc: GUI for Syncthing - a continuous file synchronization program.

resources.name: TheDistributedBay ☠️
resources.desc: P2P rewrite of the Open Bay/Pirate Bay. It uses a completely distributed protocol to share entries between numerous nodes. This makes it nearly impossible to take down by seizure of servers. Each node contains a complete copy, and any changes are propagated through the network.

resources.name: Ticktack ☠
resources.desc: Decentralized social platform for people to share knowledge and exchange value, with P2P messaging encrypted feature. Built on top of Secure Scuttlebutt (SSB).

resources.name: Tox
resources.desc: Instant messaging application, without central servers. The system is distributed, peer-to-peer, and end-to-end encrypted.

resources.name: twtxt
resources.desc: Decentralized microblogging platform "for hackers" based on text files. The user is "followed" and "mentioned" by referencing the URL to their twtxt.txt file and a nickname.

resources.name: Vdo.Ninja
resources.desc: 100% free; no downloads; no personal data collection; no sign-in, cutting edge Peer-to-Peer forwarding technology that offers privacy and ultra-low latency

resources.name: webcat ☠️
resources.desc: P2P pipe across the web using webrtc that uses Github private/public key for authentication and a signalhub for discovery. Can send text or files.

resources.name: WebTorrent Desktop
resources.desc: WebTorrent Desktop is for streaming torrents. It connects to both BitTorrent and WebTorrent peers.

resources.name: YaCy
resources.desc: Free distributed search engine, built on principles of P2P networks.

resources.name: ZeroNet
resources.desc: Open, free and uncensorable websites, using Bitcoin cryptography and BitTorrent network. Uncensored, no hosting costs, always accessible.

resources.name: ArcBlock
resources.desc: ArcBlock is a decentralized developer platform that simplifies the development of DApps, DLT and Blockchains.

resources.name: m-ld
resources.desc: A software library enabling distributed applications to read and write shared information consistently with zero latency, using Semantic Web technology and CRDTs (Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types).

resources.name: Solid
resources.desc: Solid was created by the inventor of the World Wide Web, Sir Tim Berners-Lee. Solid is a specification that lets people store their data securely in decentralized data stores called Pods. Pods are like secure personal web servers for your data. For developer resources, see Developer Resources. For a listing of some Solid applications, see Solid Applications.

resources.name: Blockstack
resources.desc: The new decentralized internet. Platform for application development with built in decentralized DNS.

resources.name: Cryptosphere ☠️
resources.desc: Open-source P2P web application platform for decentralized, privacy-preserving software which keeps users in control of their own content.

resources.name: okTurtles
resources.desc: DNSChain = Secure Blockchain Access and BlockchainID = decentralized web login.

resources.name: Blockply
resources.desc: Blockply is a collection of the most interesting & outstanding Blockchain projects.

resources.name: DataToken
resources.desc: A decentralized access control system for off-chain data sharing and monetization. Its vision is to make the data flows more transparent, by returning data ownership to its owners while maintaining the computability of data.

resources.name: Hyphanet
resources.desc: Hyphanet is a peer-to-peer platform for censorship-resistant and privacy-respecting publishing and communication. The original Freenet.

resources.name: GNUnet
resources.desc: GNUnet is a network protocol stack for building secure, distributed, and privacy-preserving applications. The Internet of tomorrow needs GNUnet today.

resources.name: Gun
resources.desc: A cybersecurity protocol for syncing decentralized graph data; GUN is an ecosystem of tools that let you build community run and encrypted applications - like an Open Source Firebase or a Decentralized Dropbox.
